subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 are written on different faces of a dice, Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60d6e8097c034ccb010df74044f462081561bbfd960a5d0e4b96c44f5393c01b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 9, 8, 7, and 2 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 3the will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c31214a493c8022ebedfeb2ecf53eebf0a4272f64114e7859f70a99cc77a80cd.png] 

Opposite pairs:

8 → 2

9 → 7

5 → 3

So, the opposite side of "5" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
